about.desc: RTSPcamTG is an IP camera monitoring system over RTSP with YOLOv8 object detection and instant Telegram alerts. Runs fully locally, with no cloud dependencies.
about.feature_rtsp: RTSP stream monitoring with automatic reconnect
about.feature_polygon: Polygon detection zones with a visual editor in the Web UI
about.feature_telegram: Telegram alerts with a photo and the camera name
about.feature_local: No cloud dependencies, local and dockerized
